description: This file contains the implementation of the idle thread and power management functions for the Zephyr RTOS kernel, including low power state handling, CPU idle loop, and architecture-specific spin relaxation.

methods.name: z_pm_save_idle_exit
methods.description: Handles system resume from low power states, calling pm_system_resume and sys_clock_idle_exit if configured.

methods.name: idle
methods.description: Main idle thread function that manages CPU idling, low power states, and scheduler cooperation.

methods.name: arch_spin_relax
methods.description: Weakly defined function to relax CPU spinlock, asserting IRQs are disabled and executing a no-op.
